description:
Declare the evidence, blocker and warning codes of artifact plans through the vocabulary macro.

## Background

`EvidenceCode`, `BlockerCode` and `WarningCode` (`crates/jit/src/domain/artifact_plan.rs:369,408,497`) each pair a kebab-case serde rename with a hand-written `ALL` and `const fn as_str`. Codes are sorted by `as_str` (`artifact_plan.rs:1224,1228`, `domain/artifact_inventory.rs:261-262`, `repository_state/archive.rs:337-338`). The external wire contract is pinned by `crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/artifact_plan_model_tests.rs:343,355,373`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The three code enums are declared through the macro, and their hand-written `ALL` and `as_str` are gone.
- [hard] REQ-02: Code ordering still follows the wire spelling, so plan output order is unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: The artifact-plan wire-contract suite passes unchanged.
title: Artifact-plan codes declare their wire spelling once
